allow.reason: PUT /api/v1/sovereign/release starts the release Job itself until SOV-520 makes it a commit that release-sync reads (#7922)

POST /api/v1/deployments/{id}/network-registry writes, from the parent, the registry ConfigMap that the hand-over writes into each region of a Sovereign; the parent holds the OpenTofu state it comes from and no Git of the Sovereign (#7938)

PUT and DELETE /api/v1/org/applications/{name} are the Organization-confined twins of PUT and DELETE /api/v1/sovereigns/{id}/applications/{name}: the same handler writes the same Application CR, already counted under CTL-162; they move with their twins when CTL-162 makes that write a commit
